metadata.description: Erlangen Cricket Club members' app: match and practice availability, attendance and squad selection.

week.preview: Preview with sample data, shown as {date}

banner.allDoneText: You have answered for everything this week.

reason.title: Not going?
reason.description: Tell your captain why. Only you, your captain and the Board see it.
reason.label: Reason
reason.motion: ECC league matches come first: not going to play tennis- or tape-ball cricket is not allowed (motion 2026/03).

attendance.title: Practice attendance
attendance.met: You can be selected. These practices count for {day}'s match.
attendance.needs: Attend {needed} of the next {of, plural, one {practice} other {# practices}} to be selected.
attendance.out: You can't be selected for this match: 2 of the last 4 practices are needed (motion 2023/01).
attendance.notActive: The 2-of-4 rule starts once 4 practices have taken place.

week.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: With your club account: the same email and password as on the club website.
signIn.help: No account yet, or forgot your password? Ask the Board for a personal link.
signIn.error: Signing in is not possible right now. Please try again.

rejected.credentials: Email or password is not right.
rejected.locked: Too many attempts: your account is locked for a while. Try again later.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

unlinked.title: Almost there
unlinked.text: Your account is not linked to a player yet. Ask the Board to link it, then your week appears here.

noSquad.title: No team yet
noSquad.text: You are not in a team squad yet. The Board assigns you to ECC I or ECC II.

quiet.title: A quiet week
quiet.text: No matches or practices for your team this week.

weekState.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.
